answer: Burn registry: minting an identity requires burning 500 POA to a public null address, the receipt logged on-chain against each key. An operator building a grove of 50 fake agents burns 25,000 tokens up front, money gone forever, refunds impossible whether the fakes ever earn anything. Each epoch a random verifier reconciles burn receipts against the token contract; a receipt matching no registered key forfeits that key's whole reward pool. The voyage from first fake to payout gets priced at the door, and the burn log is one knoll every identity must climb alone, with no refund at the top.
